name: HSCJ233125-005216 (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant galaxy HSCJ233125-005216, seen by Hubble.
label: hscj233125005216-hubble
story: Somewhere in this field lies HSCJ233125-005216, one of a handful of exceptionally bright galaxies from the epoch of reionization, found by Subaru's Hyper Suprime-Cam survey and rivaling the famous Himiko and CR7. Hubble looked to map the shape of its ultraviolet starlight.

claims.text: HSCJ233125-005216 is a high-redshift galaxy, a target of Hubble program 16641
The Subaru Hyper Suprime-Cam survey discovered seven epoch-of-reionization galaxies as bright as Himiko and CR7
The program aims to identify the rest-frame UV continuum morphology of these galaxies
